name: architecture-cartographer
description: Architecture Cartographer CLI surface. Schema-validated against cli-manifest/v1 and cross-validated against the per-domain Connect-RPC proto descriptors at test time. Loaded by cli/main.go via cliapp.LoadFromManifest.

groups.name: graph
groups.description: Extract architecture graphs by composing language code-graph adapters

commands.name: extract
commands.description: Extract a normalized cross-language graph for a target scenario

omitted.reason: Snapshots are intermediate state owned by the API; CLI consumers retrieve them via `graph extract <scenario>` which returns the snapshot inline. A standalone `graph get <id>` will land alongside the snapshot-history feature.
Snapshot history is an API-side audit surface; the CLI exposes only the freshest snapshot per scenario today. A `graph list <scenario>` command will land alongside snapshot-history UX.
Cache invalidation is administrative; will be exposed via an explicit admin-only subcommand once governance metadata for destructive cache ops is finalized.
Export is a tooling-side concern (fixture authoring, offline analysis); will land alongside the fixture-validator surface.
